C-GRACE4-LIFECYCLE-HARDENING.Summary: Close lifecycle, scope and check-context gaps left after the initial GRACE 4 governance merge.
C-GRACE4-LIFECYCLE-HARDENING.Problem: The initial contour validates approved implementation changes and database migrations, but durable GRACE context and several repository surfaces can still change without a matching C-*; branch pushes do not distinguish draft, planned and implementation stages; PR and post-merge check contexts are ambiguous; and terminal archiving is not proven byte-preserving.

Goals.Goal: Govern every repository surface except direct lifecycle XML that is validated by dedicated active/archive transition rules.
Select current, baseline or final GRACE assertions from the actual branch stage.
Reject active-only integration PRs and require completed governed work or one terminal archive-only transition.
Prove that archiving preserves the exact bundle and changes only matching root lifecycle statuses.
Publish unambiguous branch, pull-request and post-merge GRACE check contexts while preserving the exact-SHA aggregate gate.

Constraints.Constraint: No application behavior, database schema, release version, runtime dependency or offline bundle changes are permitted.
The existing exact-SHA merge gate, durable model gate, append-only migration gate and required project checks remain mandatory.
The approved change scope remains explicit and fail-closed; no automatic widening is permitted.
Server-side branch protection remains an administrative setting represented by the committed desired-state script.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Introduce gRPC transport or any production network service.
Replace GRACE CLI validation with a repository-local parser.
Change project features, records, migrations or deployment topology.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Draft branches use current assertions, approved planned branches use baseline assertions, and governed implementation branches use final assertions with leaf commands.
A pull request containing only an active proposal fails.

Application code, tests, scripts, workflows, root configuration, documentation, and durable GRACE context/graph/verification changes require exactly one matching active C-* and remain inside ObservedWriteScope.
An archive-only pull request preserves the exact file set, preserves companion files byte-for-byte, changes only root spec/plan status to one equal terminal value, and leaves no active copy.
Branch, pull-request and post-merge runs publish distinct contract, database and aggregate check names; pull-request protection continues to require GRACE / merge-gate.
Governance regression tests and the existing project/database checks pass for one exact head SHA.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Staged lifecycle tests, immutable archive tests, event-specific GitHub checks and all exact-SHA project gates are successful.

Assumptions.Assumption: main contains the initial GRACE 4 contour and C-GRACE4-GOVERNANCE is terminally archived before this change starts.
The graph and verification anchors introduced by the initial contour remain current.
